explanation:
The central tree is reduced from 116 to 70 lines (39.7%) and from 8,478 to 5,234 characters (38.3%). It retains responsibilities and main handoffs. Five peripherals contain detailed validation, retry decisions, record publication, evidence transport, and diagram identity checks. M = modular structure, C = call flow, O = ownership, D = data dependency.

The critique is addressed by relocating numeric limits, locking sequences and validation exceptions, attaching expansions at meaningful concepts, and placing peripherals near their central anchors. Comment retries have a separate metadata anchor from create/fork retries. Textual pointers to source, storage and diagrams use the relationships supplied in context.json; no other point is recreated. The JSON passed schema validation. All diagrams are connected, edge endpoints were checked, and measured text rectangles do not overlap. Rendered connector routing remains unverified.

Grounding: agentContext.ts supplies validation/conversion; agentContextLibrary.ts and savedAgentContext.ts supply reuse and metadata contracts; fileAgentContextRepository.ts supplies receipts and publication; fileAgentContextSources.ts supplies capture/transport; diagramAgentContext.ts supplies compilation and backing checks. Details absent from the seed include missing-attachment acceptance, repeated-reference byte accounting, insertion-order cache eviction, sourceId fallback, optional inline descriptor hashes, and full-record reads behind summaries.

Corrections: missing-link/cycle checks cover only the traversed trajectory slice, while entry-ID uniqueness covers all supplied entries. Identical comment retries return before checking the current snapshot hash, correcting the seed's blanket stale-hash failure claim. Diagram loading verifies backing identity without comparing current evidence or revision; background text requests current diagram input, but these files do not establish that later requests supply it. The source adapter enforces 16 MiB despite stale 2 MiB wording. HEAD reuse compares file-representation hashes after LF/CRLF splitting, so the seed's exact-byte wording is narrowed. Portable conversion recomputes the descriptor hash without guaranteeing a different value.

The critique's proposed reconciliation with agent-API status behavior cannot be verified from the pinned inputs. That behavior and external diagram IDs are therefore not imported as evidence; the freshness limitation is explicitly local to the supplied functions. Imported source-range helpers, ImmutableRecords internals, and session-launch callers remain outside the supplied evidence. Previous output and critique served only as review material and were not modified.
